name: inverse
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::inverse(Tensor self) -> Tensor. Computes a matrix inverse without mutating or aliasing self. Tests cover square matrices on small fused and large delegated paths, batches, matrices requiring pivoting, inverse-product residuals, noncontiguous inputs, empty batches, supported float32/float64, low-precision rejection, and explicit rejection of unsupported FlagGems autograd.
